title: Fine-Tuning of Transformer models with Frames
abstract: arXiv:2608.26430v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) strategies such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) are effective solutions for fine-tuning large-scale pre-trained models; however, their memory requirements scale with the size of the model, $\mathcal{O}(dr)$, where $d$ is the model's hidden dimension and $r$ is the rank. Our proposal, FrameFT, models the parameter update $\Delta W$ with a sparse coefficient matrix in a Fusion Frame basis. Fusion Frames can be generated algorithmically and shared across model layers, enabling very efficient updates. Only the sparse coefficients of the basis expansion are stored/optimized, reducing the memory footprint. The sparse structure of the coefficient matrix in FrameFT and the sparsity in the Fusion Frames give large compute benefits, and our analysis provides formal convergence results. translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26430v1 公告类型：新 摘要：参数高效微调（PEFT）策略，如低秩适应（LoRA），是微调大规模预训练模型的有效解决方案；然而，其内存需求随模型大小呈 $\mathcal{O}(dr)$ 规模增长，其中 $d$ 是模型的隐藏维度，$r$ 是秩。我们的提议 FrameFT，在融合帧基中，用稀疏系数矩阵建模参数更新 $\Delta W$。融合帧可以算法生成，并在模型各层之间共享，从而实现非常高效的更新。只有基展开的稀疏系数被存储/优化，从而减少了内存占用。FrameFT 中系数矩阵的稀疏结构以及融合帧中的稀疏性带来了巨大的计算优势，我们的分析提供了形式化的收敛结果。我们在监督微调基准套件上评估了该想法，重点针对语言任务，但也报告了应用情况。
tldr: FrameFT 利用融合帧基的稀疏系数矩阵来高效微调Transformer模型，显著降低内存和计算开销，同时保持收敛性能。
en_tdlr: FrameFT efficiently fine-tunes Transformer models by using sparse coefficient matrices in a Fusion Frame basis, significantly reducing memory and compute costs while maintaining convergence.
